environment.gpu: 01:00.0 VGA compatible controller: NVIDIA Corporation AD104 [GeForce RTX 4070 Ti] (rev a1)
environment.sampling: serial independent processes; no concurrent build or other task benchmark

runner.methodology: matches run-matrix.ps1; all subprocesses run sequentially

measurement.append: append/continuation + processHistory + publish calls; excludes generation/hash/pacing
measurement.ingest_cpu: process user+kernel including worker, generation/hash/ingestion/settle; not receive CPU
measurement.scan: cursor reads + chars[0] checksum before cold-cache sampling; excludes full-field verification
measurement.throughput: Cell storage MiB/s (sizeof(Cell)); not transport byte throughput
measurement.cold: first CacheOnly request to Found for distinct blocks; includes worker scheduling; not GUI frame
measurement.memory: resident_charge before reads; RSS after ingestion; peak RSS includes batches/verification
measurement.percentiles: nearest rank per process; summaries median/min/max of process percentiles
